https://telex.hu/karakter/konyvespolc/20.text: Menü Kereső Meghalt Vladimír Páral, A száz százalékos nő szerzője Könyvespolc Vass Norbert Augusztus 10-én, a 94. születésnapján halt meg Vladimír Páral cseh író, akinek több könyve is nagy sikert aratott a világban és Magyarországon, írja az MTI. Páralnak a múlt század hatvanas éveitől kezdve mintegy kéttucatnyi regénye és elbeszélése jelent meg, melyek közül több mint tíz magyar nyelven is olvasható. Páral Prágában született, 1932-ben, a főiskolai tanulmányait Pardubicében végezte a Vegyipari Főiskolán. Ezt követően Ústí nad Labemben dolgozott vegyészmérnökként. 1967 és 1972 között, valamint 1979-től szabadfoglalkozású író volt, 1972 és 1979 között pedig a Severočeské kiadó szerkesztőjeként tevékenykedett. Páral számos kötetét világnyelvekre is lefordították, hét regényéből film készült. Legismertebb kötetei az Ústí nad Labem vegyi laborában játszódó Gyilkosok és szeretők című haláltáncregény, amely magyarul Hosszú Ferenc fordításában jelent meg, Az ifjú ember és a fehér bálna című kötet, amelynek ugyancsak a vegyi üzem a helyszíne, vegytani kiseposz az alcíme, és Hap Béla fordította le, valamint a csehszlovák Hamupipőke-történetet kínáló A száz százalékos nő. Utóbbiban Páral a hatvanas évek első felében kispolgárivá szelídülő Csehszlovákia világa elé tartott görbe tükröt. Páral regényeinek központi témáját a partneri kapcsolatok alkották, de idősebb korában sci-fi-regényeket is írt. Kövess minket Facebookon is! Követem! Legfontosabb Friss hírek

https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/15/new-.text: A new four-lane road bridge linking China and North Korea finally opened on Thursday, 12 years late, enabling the Asian giant and its isolated nuclear-armed neighbour to substantially step up cross-border trade.China is North Korea's largest trading partner and a vital diplomatic and political backer, although relations have not always been smooth with the ruling Kim dynasty.Hundreds of people gathered on Thursday in the northern Chinese border town of Dandong, taking selfies in front of the 3,026-metre New Yalu River vehicle bridge before it opened.Trucks bearing the nations' flags began moving in both directions late in the morning, with some of the North Korean vehicles decorated with flowers."It's great," one woman who came to watch told the AFP news agency in the town dotted with Chinese as well as Korean shops and restaurants, where residents were relieved the bridge had finally open."It's already been over 10 years. It's certainly going to be good for business," she said, without wishing to be named, accompanied by her friend and her dog."I hope the standard of living in North Korea can rise to the level we have here," Dandong local Yu Shuyan, who before the pandemic had visited North Korea, said.Chinese Premier Li Qiang said that the bridge symbolised Beijing's friendship with Pyongyang and that relations were "entering a new stage and opening a new chapter"."Thanks to the joint efforts of both sides, the successful opening of the bridge will not only strongly boost economic and trade cooperation between the two countries, but will also further facilitate people-to-people exchanges and tighten the bonds of affection between the two peoples," Li said by video link at the opening ceremony, China’s Xinhua news agency reported.The structure was completed in 2014 but its opening was delayed due to a lack of connecting roads and customs facilities on the North Korean side, South Korea's Yonhap news agency reported.North Korea also sealed its borders during the COVID-19 pandemic and train journeys between the East Asian neighbours only restarted in March after a six-year halt.The new bridge is not the only border crossing between the two countries.But the new structure will supersede the "extremely narrow" rail-and-road Sino-Korean Friendship Bridge downstream on the Yalu River, said Lim Eul-chul, a North Korea expert at Kyungnam University."Previously, transporting heavy cargo such as industrial machinery, raw materials, construction materials and energy-related supplies required extreme caution because of safety concerns surrounding the ageing bridge," Lim told AFP."The new crossing will make such shipments much easier and more efficient," he said, calling it a "groundbreaking development" that will substantially increase cargo traffic.Russia-North Korea bridgeThe new bridge's launch came about a month after North Korea and Russia opened a road bridge as part of their efforts to cement relations.Experts say Chinese officials likely felt uneasy about its opening.China has long been North Korea’s biggest trading partner and economic pipeline. But in recent years, North Korean leader Kim Jong-un has prioritised Moscow, sending thousands of troops and conventional weapons to support Russian President Vladimir Putin’s war in Ukraine, apparently in exchange for military and economic assistance.But Kim has recently drawn closer to China with the apparent intent to improve his country's economy and build a front against the United States.China, for its part, wants to restore its unique influence over North Korea. Last year, about 98% of North Korea’s external trade was with China.North Korea has not yet resumed issuing tourism visas to Chinese citizens, who once made up the bulk of its overseas visitors.South Korea's unification ministry said that Seoul is "closely monitoring" the situation regarding the new bridge.

Log in A year before Poland’s general election, the country's main opposition leader suggested that countries led by nationalist parties could open negotiations to leave the European Union to pressure it to return powers to member states. “The European Union must be changed. This is my deep conviction, shared by my party and, I believe, very many Poles,” Jarosław Kaczyński, the leader of the national-conservative Law and Justice , said Wednesday at an economic forum in southern Poland. He said EU institutions like the European Commission , the EU's executive body, have too much influence, but that upcoming elections in France and Spain, which could bring far-right politicians to power, could open the way for discussions about change. He offered several ideas for change, including having national parliamentarians monitor how often EU bodies break EU law. But as a last resort, he suggested that countries seeking reform could conclude a new treaty that would take effect at a later date while simultaneously opening EU withdrawal negotiations. He presented that as a way to pressure other countries and EU bodies to accept changes. His remarks sparked criticism from senior government figures in Poland. “Jarosław Kaczyński has just announced that Poland should begin negotiations on the conditions of leaving the European Union," the pro-European prime minister, Donald Tusk , wrote on X. Kaczyński accused Tusk of misrepresenting his intentions. “We want the union to benefit not the elites, but the ordinary citizens,” Kaczyński shot back on X. Poland, a key country on NATO’s eastern flank and one of the EU’s fastest-growing economies, has gained strategic importance in recent years, partly through its crucial role in supporting Ukraine. Kaczyński’s party led Poland between 2015 and 2023, leading to major conflicts with EU institutions over the rule of law and human rights. One year ahead of general elections, polls indicate that Kaczyński could bring his party back to power if he allies with smaller far-right groups that have been on the rise in Poland in recent years. Kaczyński said the EU reform he is advocating was focused on “improving citizens' living conditions, lowering energy prices, strengthening security, pursuing a responsible migration policy and an ambitious economic and agricultural policy without unnecessary bureaucracy.” Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski said Kaczyński's remarks should help Polish voters understand the consequences of choosing the far-right. “I thank Jarosław Kaczyński for his honesty,” Sikorski said. The Mexican president took a South China Airlines flight from Mexico City to Shenzhen, with posts going viral on China's Weibo social media site seemingly showing Sheinbaum chatting with other passengers on board. She posted a short video on social media showing her being greeted by Chinese officials and schoolchildren after getting off an airport bus, as well as an earlier post showing her waiting in Mexico City's airport departures lounge. A hashtag on Weibo about her arrival attracted more than 10 million views, with users voicing admiration for her low-cost intercontinental travel. "It's commendable to spend taxpayer money frugally and ensure it's used where it's most needed, rather than squandering it on luxurious private jets or official travel expenses," the AFP news agency cited one user as saying. Sheinbaum is promoting an austerity program launched by her predecessor, Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador, who put the Mexican presidential plane up for sale in 2023. She traveled with a large delegation of ministers to Shenzhen. China has become particularly sensitive to the idea of corruption and wasteful public spending in recent years amid high-profile and long-running anti-corruption measures launched by President Xi Jinping, seemingly at least partly as damage-limitation efforts following a series of scandals. "I look forward to an in-depth exchange of views with you on major issues concerning China-US relations, Asia-Pacific cooperation, and the global landscape," Xi told Trump. He said the talks would take place "with the aim of advancing a constructive, strategically stable relationship between our two nations — one built upon the foundations of mutual respect, fairness and reciprocity." Despite Trump and Xi's efforts to regularly hold friendly face-to-face talks in recent months, the US and China are nevertheless embroiled in difficult trade negotiations as the two superpowers try to reconcile competing interests on various issues. These are some of the most advanced Nvidia products licensed for export by the US government; the company had sold such goods worth $2.4 billion (roughly €2.2 billion) in the previous quarter, Colette Kress said. Kress replaced Jensen Huang following his resignation last week and amid the scandal over alleged Chinese attempts both to gain intelligence on the company's CEO and to circumvent import restrictions. "Our guidance does not have any licensed Hopper data center products included, and we are no longer shipping licensed Hopper data center products to China," Kress said. She did not specify why such deliveries had currently stopped or say whether the step would be permanent. Huang was influential in persuading Donald Trump to allow sales of H200 Hopper processors used to train and run advanced AI models to China, reversing export controls the US had imposed in 2022 under Trump's predecessor Joe Biden. China has called the allegations of espionage targeting Nvidia unfounded and threatened to respond in kind if restrictions on trade follow as a result of the fallout from Huang's resignation.
